Your curb is community infrastructure — the most leveraged real estate your city manages. CivicSmart
helps cities unlock its full community value with a connected platform across all four layers: smart
hardware at the space, real-time intelligence on every event, predictable and fair enforcement, and
the operations system that ties them together. The result is more turnover for merchants, more
curb-adjacent commerce, more sales tax to the treasury, and public trust in a system that finally
works for everyone who uses it.

The challenge

## The curb is broken — for everyone.

Nobody wins under the current curbside status quo. Cities manage blind. Motorists are frustrated.
And revenue and commerce slips through gaps no one can see.

#### High friction at the curb

The sign is already behind the driver. Rampant safety violations — fire lanes, crosswalks, ADA
spaces. Enforcement that feels like a bad-luck lottery. Honest drivers turn into accidental
violators because the rules weren’t visible at the moment of decision.

#### Commerce left on the table

For a 5,000-space downtown, every missed turnover is roughly $100–$200M in unrealized annual
commerce and $5–$15M in unrealized sales tax. Most of that gap is information at the decision point,
not anything more exotic.

#### “Asset-light” experiments that aren’t

Strip the hardware off the curb and the only signal that says “this is a legal space” goes with it.
Compliance drops. Fire lanes fill up. The city ends up with the worst of both worlds: complex rules
and no way to read them at the curb.

A note on hardware

**Remove the meter and you remove the signal.** App-only and kiosk-only schemes are sold as
convenience, but nobody thinks a half-block walk to a kiosk is convenient. They erase the curb
signal that tells a driver in motion “this is a legal space, here are the rules” — the one part of
the system that addresses the 2-second commit window. They also disadvantage cash-only, unbanked and
non-smartphone drivers.

[**Read why the decision happens in 2 seconds »**][34]

The complete curbside stack

## Seven product lines. One integrated system.

From the meter at the space to the citation on the officer’s screen — every layer engineered to work
with every other, out of the box.

LNG (Classic) and SpaceMaster (Modernistic) — single-space and multi-space meters with integrated
sensor options.

### [Curbside Intelligence][37]

SpaceMaster integrated sensors and CurbMaster dedicated curb sensors. Real-time occupancy, plate
capture, evidence-grade detection.

[See curb sensing][38]
[FLPR lane device alongside SpaceMaster in a lane configuration]

### [Lane Management][39]

LaneMaster and LaneMaster Solar — automated lane management for loading, pickup-dropoff, rideshare
and commercial corridors.

[See lane management][40]
[One-piece AutoISSUE handheld alongside Mobile LPR camera]

### [Enforcement][41]

AutoISSUE handhelds for officers on the beat. Guided enforcement (35–50% capture) upgrades to full
automation (80% capture) when the city is ready.

## Make your city more liveable

You know our parking app – but did you know we do improve parking and traffic flows in cities? We
collaborate with city administrators, policy makers, private operators, tech partners, businesses
and yourself to make cities more liveable.

[Mobile paid parking][Mobile paid parking]

**Mobile Paid Parking**

Millions of drivers worldwide already use a parking app. Get access to smart and flexible parking
from your mobile phone or your car’s display.


[Read more][44]
[EVC][EVC]

**Electric Vehicle Charging **

Get to the nearest charging pole with the EasyPark app. While you’re at it, use the app to start
both the charging and the parking.


[Read more][45]
[icon][icon]

**Camera Parking**

Because smart parking can become even smarter. After activation in the app, the parking and possibly
the payment are handled completely automatically the next time you drive in and out of parking
spaces.

### CSA's Cryogenic Buyer's Guide

The CSA's Cryogenic Buyer's Guide is divided into two sections: Products and Services. The
categories are listed alphabetically in each section. Entries in the guide for CSA Corporate
Sustaining Members have a more complete description of their capabilities and a link to their
websites to find additional information or request a quote. Click "Suppliers" to view an
alphabetical listing.

### [ Products ][18]

### [ Services ][19]

### [ Suppliers ][20]

[CF-BG-2025-cover]

## What is the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide?

Designed for cryogenic applications and provided by the [Cryogenic Society of America][21] (CSA),
this product and service resource includes everything from adhesives, cryocoolers, dewars and
electronic controls to greases, liquefiers, magnets, tanks, test chambers, valves and wire used in
ultra-low temperature applications.

Here, you can also find engineering consultants, research and test laboratories, specialty
manufacturing, cryogenic treatment services, materials research and cryogenic transport services.
You can find company profiles for leading companies in cryogenics, as well as contact information
for many more suppliers.

If you can't find what you're looking for in the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide, [contact us][22], and
we'll help you find answers. We constantly update the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide to include the latest
information on sources for cryogenic products and services.

The CSA also publishes this Buyer's Guide each December in [Cold Facts][23] magazine, which all CSA
members receive by mail as a benefit of their membership. Contact the CSA for the availability of
back issues.

### Submit your application to be listed in the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide

The purpose of the CSA's Cryogenic Buyer's Guide is to provide an easy reference for visitors
searching for cryogenic products or services and help them quickly find what they're looking for. If
you are a cryogenic product or service supplier, you should be listed in our Buyer's Guide.

[ Get Started ][24]

## PURPOSE & OBJECTIVES OF THE CSA

The CSA's purpose and objectives are to do the following:
* Encourage the dissemination of information concerning low temperature processes and techniques
* Bring together those in all disciplines concerned with the applications of low temperature
  technology
* Promote research and development of low temperature processes by meetings, professional contacts,
  papers, reports and publications
* Increase public awareness of the usefulness of cryogenic technology

## About the CSA

The CSA is a nonprofit technical society serving all those interested in any phase of cryogenics,
the art and science of achieving extremely low temperatures — almost absolute zero.

## What is the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide?

Designed for cryogenic applications and provided by the [Cryogenic Society of America][21] (CSA),
this product and service resource includes everything from adhesives, cryocoolers, dewars and
electronic controls to greases, liquefiers, magnets, tanks, test chambers, valves and wire used in
ultra-low temperature applications.

Here, you can also find engineering consultants, research and test laboratories, specialty
manufacturing, cryogenic treatment services, materials research and cryogenic transport services.
You can find company profiles for leading companies in cryogenics, as well as contact information
for many more suppliers.

If you can't find what you're looking for in the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide, [contact us][22], and
we'll help you find answers. We constantly update the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide to include the latest
information on sources for cryogenic products and services.

The CSA also publishes this Buyer's Guide each December in [Cold Facts][23] magazine, which all CSA
members receive by mail as a benefit of their membership. Contact the CSA for the availability of
back issues.

### Submit your application to be listed in the Cryogenic Buyer's Guide

searching for cryogenic products or services and help them quickly find what they're looking for. If
you are a cryogenic product or service supplier, you should be listed in our Buyer's Guide.

## PURPOSE & OBJECTIVES OF THE CSA

The CSA's purpose and objectives are to do the following:
* Encourage the dissemination of information concerning low temperature processes and techniques
* Bring together those in all disciplines concerned with the applications of low temperature
  technology
* Promote research and development of low temperature processes by meetings, professional contacts,
  papers, reports and publications
* Increase public awareness of the usefulness of cryogenic technology

## About the CSA

The CSA is a nonprofit technical society serving all those interested in any phase of cryogenics,
the art and science of achieving extremely low temperatures — almost absolute zero.

1. **Demand Forecasting & Dynamic Pricing**
* Use historical data and real-time analytics to predict peak usage times.

and sustainable. Are you considering integrating any of these technologies? I’d be happy to explore

# Parking Equipment & Systems

Our products include garage pre cashiering machines, [ticket dispensers][53], gate vending
equipment, and [ticket validators][54]. We also provide electronic aids including fee computers,
electronic counters, and access control read systems for optimum efficiency in parking structures.

Parking Systems, Inc. offers the option for custom-built equipment to suit the needs of a variety of
parking sites. We also manufacture specialty electronics such as our C5 All-in-One Low Speed LPR
system and Parking Guidance System. These advanced systems are easily customizable for your site,
providing maximum security and ease of use at any location outfitted with Parking Systems, Inc.
technology.

[Contact Parking Systems, Inc.][55] by telephone or [email][56] to place your order and begin your
parking equipment installation.

## C5 All-in-One LPR System

C5 is an all-in-one system for LPR, access control. Typically used for low-speed applications, C5 is
embedded with a microprocessor, camera and illumination unit and all LPR functions are automated
within the system.

[MORE INFO][57]

## Parking Guidance System

The ultra sonic sensor for car detection is a key component in the guidance system. At regular
intervals, the sensor emits an ultrasonic pulse and measures the time delay until the echo pulse is
received.

[MORE INFO][58]

# Meet solution that is transforming the parking industry!

[video image][play]

## Why Parqour?

Parqour offers a comprehensive end-to-end management platform to increase revenue, reduce
operational cost and enhance transparency.

Say goodbye to piecing together different vendors and integrations. No need to spend huge capital on
bulky hardware. Control all operations from one platform.

Contactless parking and online payment methods makes the parking experience easier for your
customers too. The end result: higher utilization and lower operating costs.
* 99,6% license plate recognition rate
* Online QR payment & 3rd party APIs
  
  (integrated with Parkmobile, SpotHero, Honk, PayByPhone)
* Data analytics
  
  (real-time occupancy, revenue, utilization, parking trends)
* Validation and permit management
  
  (free flow access for approved drivers)
* 24/7 remote control system
* Hardware with zero upfront costs
* Zoning and violation detection
  
  (control POD, VIP and nested zones)

# How does it work?

#### Use case: gated/gate-less paid parking
* ### Drive-in
  
  The license plate is automatically detected and the system starts parking session
* ### Park & register
  
  First time visitors will be instructed to scan QR and register once
* ### Drive-out
  
  Driver is charged automatically

# About us

Car parks often provide the first impression of a destination. We focus on transforming the parking
customer experience into one that is a welcome part of any journey.

We are a global technology company with extended expertise and experience in parking management,
proptech, smart city and smart parking technologies.

Founded in 2020, Parqour already has more than 150 employees. It is headquartered in the USA with
offices or representatives in 22 countries across Europe, the Middle-East, Central Asia and
South-East Asia.

We know you have better things to worry about than paying for your parking. That’s why our smart,

## We’re **everywhere** you need us to be

We work with over 1,300 cities and operators across the UK, North America, France, Germany, and
Switzerland. More than 110 million drivers worldwide have downloaded the PayByPhone app to simplify
their parking and vehicle payments to date.

[Park now][40]

## **PayByPhone** is simple to use

### Easy to register

Unlock added benefits when you register on our app. Registering is simple and straightforward. It
takes less than 30 seconds.
[Register now ›][41]

### Easy to pay

Connect your credit or debit card to your PayByPhone account, and pay quickly and securely. Or,
where available, opt for Google Pay or Apple Pay to complete transactions.
[Pay to park now ›][42]

### Extend your parking session

Meeting run over? Want to shop for longer? No need to run back to the car to feed the meter. Simply
extend your session via our app** **
[Extend now ›][43]

# Can you see the future of your parking operation?

At ProParking we have the industry expertise, experience, and market knowledge to help you take your
parking operation to the next level of profitability and performance.


As veterans of the parking industry, we can help you define and refine the future of your parking
operation and work with you to determine your needs both now and for the future. 

## VISION

We’re Changing the Way the World Acquires Parking Solutions

We do it by starting with our experience. ProParking was created by parking experts who recognized
the best way to help clients is to understand their needs and to know what parking solutions are the
right fit. 


In a world where everyone is "the best" or "the leader", our decades of experience in the industry
uniquely positions us to provide you the insight and the consultancy to sift through the noise and
solve your parking needs like a pro.  

[shutterstock_102291688.jpg]

## SERVICES

We Deliver Exceptional Products and Services Nationwide 

ProParking services every major market in the U.S.  We provide durable, future-proof solutions
comprised of best-in-breed technology at the most cost-effective price available. 


Our team is comprised of parking industry veterans that have the institutional knowledge to inform
optimal product selection to suit your operation's unique needs. 

### PARKING SOLUTIONS: READY NOW. 
### DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE.

Parking is changing.  Both the vehicles we park and where and how we park them are being molded by
the technological innovations that are changing all of society. ProParking can help you optimize
your parking operation to accommodate both paradigms, ensuring that your efforts are rewarded now
and for years to come. 

[Read More][7]
[shutterstock_1857528415.jpg]

### TECHNOLOGY 
### FOCUSED

ProParking understands vehicle technology is rapidly advancing and that this will impact parking
operations both in their design and their operation. 


By understanding these trends we are able to identify the migration paths available and to
capitalize on them. 

 

From EV charging to self-driving vehicles and whatever else lies down the road. 

[Mountain Ridge]

Expertise, experience, and insights.

Professional Parking Technologies, LLC was founded by industry experts who understand the best
systems are comprised of the best parts.  


That's why we make the extra effort to understand your needs and your goals so that we can provide
you with the right solution to get your parking operation the road to success.

Explore Physical Security Creative Solutions for Parking, Security and Beyond!

###### [PARKING][12]

PSX Parking systems include revenue management, cash and credit card handling, gate and barrier
points, digital signage and valet solutions with fully-scalable, feature-rich software solutions
that provide maximum value for the patron, the owner and the operator.

[**Explore Parking**][13]

###### [SECURITY][14]

PSX designs and builds integrated security systems that deliver the best performance in the
industry. From CCTV, intrusion detection and access control to network video recorders and command
centers, we offer a number of options for every Security need.

[**Explore Security**][15]

###### [PHYSICAL SECURITY][16]

PSX offers a wide range of physical security solutions, including low-maintenance turnstiles, crash
barrier systems, guard booths and an unmatched selection of specialty and slide / swing gates and
gate operators that are tailored to fit every application.

[**Explore Physical Security**][17]

## The Smart Park Story

Smart Park was born out of a passion for innovation and a dedication to improving the automated
parking experience.
 

At M/s. TecX India Solutions LLP, we fuse cutting-edge design with time-tested Indian technology to
deliver SMART PARK – a world-class, cost-effective parking solution built for modern lifestyles.

 

Backed by 20+ years of R&D and creative engineering, SMART PARK is efficient, visually striking, and
supported 24/7.


 

Manufactured in M/s. MS Engineers, Talawade, Pune, we specialize in designing and producing parking
systems and commercial and industrial conveyors.

Smart Parking quick facts

## Make the operator prove the parking charge.

Smart Parking does not issue council penalty charges. It issues private parking charges based on
contract terms. That means the case turns on evidence: what the signs said, what the cameras
recorded, what the payment or permit records show, and whether keeper liability was created
correctly.

The BPA currently lists Smart Parking Limited as an Approved Operator Scheme member. Smart Parking
says motorists can appeal a Parking Charge online, and its payment guidance explains that charges
can also be paid or appealed by post.

**Operator** Smart Parking Ltd
**Ticket type** Private Parking Charge Notice on private land
**Trade body route** British Parking Association Approved Operator Scheme
**First appeal** Smart Parking portal or postal appeal within the stated 28-day window
**Independent appeal** POPLA, if Smart Parking rejects and provides a valid verification code
**Evidence to check** ANPR images, payment logs, permit or validation records, signage photos,
landowner authority, and POFA wording

The Loophole Matrix

## The simple tricks Smart Parking hopes you never find out.

01

### The 14-Day Clock

Did your ticket arrive out of the blue in the post? If there was no yellow ticket left on your
windscreen, the postal notice timing matters. If Smart Parking wants keeper liability, the notice
date, delivery date, and POFA wording need to be checked before the appeal is drafted.

02

### Grace And Consideration Time

Short overstays can depend on the site rules, the time allowed to read signs, and the time taken to
leave after the parking period. The checker looks at the timestamps instead of assuming
entry-to-exit time equals parked time.

03

### ANPR And Payment Evidence

Camera images usually show entry and exit movements. They do not automatically prove when a bay was
found, when payment was made, whether a permit or validation applied, or whether a payment system
caused the issue.

### Operator evidence we want to extract
* Smart Parking portal evidence photos and ANPR timestamps.
* Payment, tariff, permit, validation, or exemption records.
* Site name, alleged contravention, amount demanded, and deadlines.
* Signs relied on by Smart Parking and whether they match the site.

### Appeal points that actually matter
* Postal notice timing and keeper liability under POFA.
* Grace period, consideration period, queuing, and exit delay evidence.
* ANPR assumptions where entry and exit are treated as parked time.
* Retail, hospital, hotel, or motorway service evidence that explains the stay.

### POPLA pressure points
* POPLA recorded 104,349 submitted appeals in its 2025 appendix.
* POPLA assessors decide using relevant law, the BPA Code of Practice, and evidence from both sides.
* A Smart Parking rejection should be answered with a complete evidence pack, not a repeated
  complaint.

Smart Parking quick facts

## Make the operator prove the parking charge.

Smart Parking does not issue council penalty charges. It issues private parking charges based on
contract terms. That means the case turns on evidence: what the signs said, what the cameras
recorded, what the payment or permit records show, and whether keeper liability was created
correctly.

The BPA currently lists Smart Parking Limited as an Approved Operator Scheme member. Smart Parking
says motorists can appeal a Parking Charge online, and its payment guidance explains that charges
can also be paid or appealed by post.

**Operator** Smart Parking Ltd
**Ticket type** Private Parking Charge Notice on private land
**Trade body route** British Parking Association Approved Operator Scheme
**First appeal** Smart Parking portal or postal appeal within the stated 28-day window
**Independent appeal** POPLA, if Smart Parking rejects and provides a valid verification code
**Evidence to check** ANPR images, payment logs, permit or validation records, signage photos,
landowner authority, and POFA wording

The Loophole Matrix

## The simple tricks Smart Parking hopes you never find out.

01

### The 14-Day Clock

Did your ticket arrive out of the blue in the post? If there was no yellow ticket left on your
windscreen, the postal notice timing matters. If Smart Parking wants keeper liability, the notice
date, delivery date, and POFA wording need to be checked before the appeal is drafted.

02

### Grace And Consideration Time

Short overstays can depend on the site rules, the time allowed to read signs, and the time taken to
leave after the parking period. The checker looks at the timestamps instead of assuming
entry-to-exit time equals parked time.

03

### ANPR And Payment Evidence

Camera images usually show entry and exit movements. They do not automatically prove when a bay was
found, when payment was made, whether a permit or validation applied, or whether a payment system
caused the issue.

Parking ticket can be challenged.

### Operator evidence we want to extract
* Smart Parking portal evidence photos and ANPR timestamps.
* Payment, tariff, permit, validation, or exemption records.
* Site name, alleged contravention, amount demanded, and deadlines.
* Signs relied on by Smart Parking and whether they match the site.

### Appeal points that actually matter
* Postal notice timing and keeper liability under POFA.
* Grace period, consideration period, queuing, and exit delay evidence.
* ANPR assumptions where entry and exit are treated as parked time.
* Retail, hospital, hotel, or motorway service evidence that explains the stay.

### POPLA pressure points
* POPLA recorded 104,349 submitted appeals in its 2025 appendix.
* POPLA assessors decide using relevant law, the BPA Code of Practice, and evidence from both sides.
* A Smart Parking rejection should be answered with a complete evidence pack, not a repeated

## Aiutiamo le Amministrazioni a creare un beneficio collettivo attraverso la gestione del
## parcheggio e dello spazio pubblico



#### Intelligente

Progettata per garantire un’efficiente gestione di tutte le attività inerenti i parcheggi su strada:
accertamento della sosta, rendicontazione, manutenzione e pianificazione.



#### Scalabile e integrabile

Soluzione tecnologica avanzata progettata per ottimizzare la gestione dei parcheggi, con la
possibilità di espandersi facilmente e interagire con altri sistemi digitali.



#### Efficiente

L’implementazione di un sistema di smart parking garantisce un’elevata rotazione, offrendo servizi
innovativi che semplificano la vita quotidiana di cittadine e cittadini, residenti, attività
economiche e persone appartenenti a categorie protette.



#### Remunerativa

L’approccio adottato non mira a sanzionare in maniera immediata, con il rischio di generare
malcontento, bensì a incentivare un utilizzo corretto e consapevole della sosta, promuovendo il
rispetto delle regole e assicurando al contempo un pagamento equo del servizio.

## Una soluzione pensata per migliorare la gestione della sosta e della mobilità urbana

### Amministrazione
* Ridisegnare il piano urbano della sosta
* Elaborare politiche e modelli previsionali
* Integrare dati ambientali e di traffico

### Gestore
* Ottimizzare la gestione in tempo reale
* Controllare e ridurre l’evasione del pagamento
* Programmare interventi mirati e migliorare la pianificazione delle risorse

### Cittadinanza
* Maggiore facilità e guida verso stalli liberi
* Gestione di permessi e abbonamenti dall’app
* Facilità d’uso e pieno rispetto della privacy

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions
* What is SpotMyPark?
  
  SpotMyPark is a platform that helps you find both free and paid parking spots easily. Our
  directory is designed to save you time and effort in locating parking spaces.
* Is there a cost to use SpotMyPark?
  
  Using SpotMyPark to find parking is free.
* Can I reserve a parking spot through SpotMyPark?
  
  SpotMyPark does not offer reservation services. We provide information on available parking spots,
  but availability is subject to change.
* What should I do if I encounter an issue with a parking spot?
  
  If you experience any issues in a parking spot, please contact the parking provider directly, we
  don't provide any support for parking spots.
* How can I contact SpotMyPark for other inquiries?
  
  You can contact us via email at contact@spotmypark.com for any questions or support needs.
* Can I list my parking in the directory?
  
  Yes, you can list your parking in SpotMyPark. Please contact us via email at
  contact@spotmypark.com .
* Are school parking lots public property?
  
  Most school parking lots are owned by the school district or institution. That means they're
  treated as private property even if they appear open to the public at certain times. Always check
  posted signs or contact the school administration before parking.
* Can I sell lemonade or food at a public park?
  
  Selling anything—including lemonade—usually requires a permit from the local municipality or parks
  department. Be sure to review your city's vending rules and obtain the necessary permit before
  setting up a stand.
* Does SpotMyPark offer a mobile app?
  
  Our responsive web app works flawlessly on modern mobile browsers. Native iOS and Android apps are
  on our roadmap if the demand continue to grow. You can require it at contact@spotmypark.com!
* How can I add my parking to SpotMyPark?
  
  You can add your parking to SpotMyPark for a $30 fee by contacting us via email at
  contact@spotmypark.com, please send us your parking details (name, address, price, description,
  pictures, google maps link, etc.) and we will add it to the directory.
* Is SpotMyPark available outside the United States?
  
  Yes. We already list parking in Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, the United
  Arab Emirates, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, India, and more coming soon.

## よくあるご質問

駐車場の空き状況について教えてください。
当サイトの車室には3種類の状態があります。
「少しお待ちいただくかもしれません」の状態でも、お問い合わせいただければお探しの状況に応じたご提案が
できますのでぜひお問い合わせください！
車庫証明を取得できますか？
お申し込み時に取得をご希望いただいたお客様には、車庫証明の取得にあたって必要な「保管場所使用承諾証明
書」を利用開始日の前日までに送付いたします。
ご契約締結後に取得をご希望いただいたお客様には、原則お問い合わせいただいた日の翌々営業日に保管場所使
用承諾証明書を発行いたします。
なお特別な事情がない限りは、発行から6か月間は駐車場ご解約のお申し入れができません。
※証明書取得の際は所定の発行手数料がかかります。

# Digital Twin Platform
# for Smart Spaces, Mobility,
# and Engagement

Digitize, Navigate, and Optimize Your Physical Environment

[Digital Twin Platform for Smart Spaces, Mobility, and Engagement]

## It All Starts with a Digital Twin

Vicinia creates a digital twin of your campus, facility, venue, or city—providing a living digital
representation of your physical environment and a foundation for smarter operations, navigation, and
experiences. By replacing fragmented systems with a connected platform, Vicinia brings together
space, mobility, and engagement into a single ecosystem.

**The Foundation For**
* A unified view of your physical environment
* Connected operational and business systems
* Real-time location, occupancy, and activity data
* Analytics that transform activity into actionable insights

### [Space Intelligence][32]

Digital mapping, space management, and asset tracking solutions that help organizations understand,
manage, and optimize their physical environments. From campus maps to occupancy visibility and asset
monitoring, Vicinia provides the tools needed to improve operational efficiency and space
utilization.
[ Maps ][33]
[ Spaces ][34]
[ Assets ][35]

### [Mobility Intelligence][36]

Wayfinding, indoor positioning, parking, and transportation solutions that help people move
efficiently through complex environments. Deliver seamless navigation experiences while improving
mobility operations across campuses, facilities, and destinations.
[ Ways ][37]
[ Parking ][38]
[ Transport ][39]
[ Indoors ][40]

### [Engagement Intelligence][41]

Visitor engagement, digital experience, and content delivery solutions that connect people with
places, services, and information. Create more engaging experiences through interactive kiosks,
self-guided tours, events, and personalized content.
[ Vibe ][42]
[ Tour ][43]

## Turn Activity Into Intelligence

Most organizations collect valuable data across dozens of disconnected systems. Vicinia’s digital
twin and IoT platform brings together sensor data, enterprise systems, and user interactions into a
single operational layer—creating a unified view of how people, spaces, assets, and services
interact across your environment.
Measure

Capture real-time data from IoT sensors, occupancy and people-flow systems, indoor positioning,
parking infrastructure, transportation networks, asset tracking technologies, and digital
touchpoints across web, mobile, and kiosks.

Understand

Combine spatial, operational, mobility, and engagement data to uncover patterns, measure
performance, and gain a clearer understanding of how your environment operates through analytics,
dashboards, visualizations, actionable insights, and compliance-ready reporting.

Optimize

Use data-driven intelligence to improve space utilization, enhance visitor experiences, optimize
resource allocation, support operational planning, evaluate what-if scenarios, and maximize the
value of physical spaces, mobility infrastructure, and revenue-generating services.

One platform.

One source of truth.

Better decisions across space, mobility,

and engagement.

## Built for Interoperability

Vicinia serves as the connective layer between the systems, sensors, and applications that already
power your environment—creating a unified platform for data, operations, and experiences.
One platform.

Connected data. Unified operations.

## Built for Complex Environments

Vicinia is purpose-built for large, dynamic environments where people, spaces, assets, and
information must work together seamlessly.

## It All Starts with a Digital Twin

Vicinia creates a digital twin of your campus, facility, venue, or city—providing a living digital
representation of your physical environment and a foundation for smarter operations, navigation, and
experiences. By replacing fragmented systems with a connected platform, Vicinia brings together
space, mobility, and engagement into a single ecosystem.

**The Foundation For**
* A unified view of your physical environment
* Connected operational and business systems
* Real-time location, occupancy, and activity data
* Analytics that transform activity into actionable insights

### [Space Intelligence][32]

Digital mapping, space management, and asset tracking solutions that help organizations understand,
manage, and optimize their physical environments. From campus maps to occupancy visibility and asset
monitoring, Vicinia provides the tools needed to improve operational efficiency and space
utilization.
[ Maps ][33]
[ Spaces ][34]
[ Assets ][35]

### [Mobility Intelligence][36]

Wayfinding, indoor positioning, parking, and transportation solutions that help people move
efficiently through complex environments. Deliver seamless navigation experiences while improving
mobility operations across campuses, facilities, and destinations.
[ Ways ][37]
[ Parking ][38]
[ Transport ][39]
[ Indoors ][40]

### [Engagement Intelligence][41]

Visitor engagement, digital experience, and content delivery solutions that connect people with
places, services, and information. Create more engaging experiences through interactive kiosks,
self-guided tours, events, and personalized content.
[ Vibe ][42]
[ Tour ][43]
[ Kiosk ][44]

## Turn Activity Into Intelligence

Most organizations collect valuable data across dozens of disconnected systems. Vicinia’s digital
twin and IoT platform brings together sensor data, enterprise systems, and user interactions into a
single operational layer—creating a unified view of how people, spaces, assets, and services
interact across your environment.
Measure

Capture real-time data from IoT sensors, occupancy and people-flow systems, indoor positioning,
parking infrastructure, transportation networks, asset tracking technologies, and digital
touchpoints across web, mobile, and kiosks.

Understand

Combine spatial, operational, mobility, and engagement data to uncover patterns, measure
performance, and gain a clearer understanding of how your environment operates through analytics,
dashboards, visualizations, actionable insights, and compliance-ready reporting.

Optimize

Use data-driven intelligence to improve space utilization, enhance visitor experiences, optimize
resource allocation, support operational planning, evaluate what-if scenarios, and maximize the
value of physical spaces, mobility infrastructure, and revenue-generating services.

One platform.

One source of truth.

Better decisions across space, mobility,

and engagement.

## Built for Interoperability

Vicinia serves as the connective layer between the systems, sensors, and applications that already
power your environment—creating a unified platform for data, operations, and experiences.
One platform.

Connected data. Unified operations.

## Built for Complex Environments

Vicinia is purpose-built for large, dynamic environments where people, spaces, assets, and
information must work together seamlessly.
